scenario: A simple lookup question stays deterministic; a bounded synthesis question uses a model with citations; only genuine unknown-trail exploration selects an agent, with justification recorded — and the escalations are auditable.

questions.text: which version of the payments library is deployed?
summarize the constraints the three collected standards impose
which services would break if the session-token format changes?

when: executors are selected for each question

reasons: q1 is answered deterministically; a model answer would be an LLM-derived fact and is rejected
q2 uses a bounded model with fixed inputs and per-finding citations to the collected material
q3 selects an agent with a recorded justification and full launch bounds
each result records its executor class and, for escalations, the justification
must_not: let a model originate the deployed version
run an agent for q1 or q2 because scripting felt inconvenient
accept q3's agent launch without depth/budget/tool bounds
